result.title: Neural Networks with Differentiable Belief-Function Layers
result.summary: Yager's 1987 rule of combination $\boxplus$ was proposed on epistemic grounds: under high conflict, mass should be redistributed to ignorance rather than renormalised onto the class simplex. We observe that backpropagation needs the same rule: Dempster's normaliser $(1{-}κ)^{-1}$, where $κ$ is the conflict mass, puts a $(1{-}κ)^{-2}$ term in the gradient that diverges exactly when evidence sources disagree, while Yager's $\boxplus$ is bilinear and has no such term. Building on this, we construct a deep evidential pipeline in which every mass in the chain from heads to output is a valid Dempster--Shafer mass function, combined by Yager's rule. The output mass on the ignorance set, $m(Θ)$, serves as the network's ``I do not know'' signal. The network is fit to hard labels and never sees an annotator distribution, yet $m(Θ)$ orders human disagreement in two modalities, visual and linguistic. Dempster's rises too and ranks contested inputs about as well, but its normaliser divides the conflict out: Yager's vacuity is $9\times$ larger on the most contested CIFAR-10H images, so only Yager's is readable as an amount of ignorance without recalibration. For out-of-distribution detection it is competitive with strong single-pass baselines, while the clamped Dempster variant that scores higher becomes gradient-unstable once the clamp is removed.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将 Yager 1987 的组合规则实现为可微层，构建每层 mass 均为合法 Dempster–Shafer 质量函数的深度证据网络，以 ignorance 集上的 m(Θ) 作为「我不知道」信号，并指出 Dempster 归一化会在证据冲突时导致梯度发散。在视觉与语言两种模态上，m(Θ) 能排序人类标注分歧，OOD 检测与强单次基线相当。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冲突时把质量留给 ignorance」的可微证据聚合与梯度稳定性分析，可能为 LVR 中多源视觉证据合并、不确定性读出及 STOP 决策提供可核查的方法线索，但尚未涉及 latent 推理状态或 VLM 生成过程。
